root.label: Trump calls for 1,000 U.S. launches per year

events.label: Trump calls for 1,000 U.S. launches per year

slots.name: annual launch target
slots.sentence: President Donald Trump, meanwhile, is calling for the development of more launch sites across the U.S., as well as upgrades to existing spaceports where rockets already lift off, in order to support 1,000 launches per year.

slots.name: launch states count
slots.sentence: Today, orbital rocket launches in the U.S. take place in Florida, Texas and California – all coastal states where rockets can fly over open water rather than populated cities.
